narrative.details:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten at Gol'Bolar Quarry.
narrative.offerRewardText: <The friend turns pale as he sees the empty keg.>...Where did you find this?
